description: FireRed-OpenStoryline is an AI video editing agent that transforms manual editing into intention-driven directing through natural language interaction, LLM-powered planning, and precise tool orchestration. It facilitates transparent, human-in-the-loop creation with reusable Style Skills for consistent, professional storytelling.

summary.one_liner: FireRed-OpenStoryline is an open-source AI video editing agent that lets you create and refine videos through natural-language conversation with LLM-driven planning.
summary.what_it_does: The project turns video creation into conversational editing: you describe the result you want and an LLM agent plans and calls editing tools. It advertises online search and download of matching images and video clips, clip segmentation and content understanding, and script generation with few-shot style transfer from reference text. It also recommends background music, voiceovers and fonts based on mood, and supports importing personal playlists with beat-syncing. Edits such as cutting, swapping, reordering clips, changing script text, color, font, stroke and position are made via natural language. Workflows can be saved as reusable Style Skills and applied to new media. Recent news items mention an ASR-based rough cut for speech videos that removes filler words, and AI transition generation via third-party AIGC services.
use_cases: Turn a folder of clips into a finished video by describing the tone
Batch-produce videos by reapplying a saved editing style to new footage
Remove filler words and repeated sentences from speech recordings
Generate a narration script in a reference copywriting style
Auto-select background music and fonts matching a mood
Create transition shots between two clips
how_to_run: conda create -n storyline python=3.11 && conda activate storyline
sh build_env.sh (Linux/macOS) or run download.sh and install requirements.txt manually
notable: Editing workflows can be saved as reusable Skills and reapplied to new media
Human-in-the-loop, natural-language-only editing of clips, scripts and visual details
Ships Agent Skills for OpenClaw and Claude Code (openstoryline-install and openstoryline-use)
Optional local ASR (storyline.local_asr) for speech rough cuts
Available as a Docker image and a HuggingFace demo
caveats: Requires API keys configured in config.toml before use
AI transitions depend on third-party AIGC services that are costly and produce unpredictable results
Commercial-grade fonts, music and VFX need a custom asset library setup; open-source assets are basic and restricted
Local ASR needs torchaudio installed separately; automatic install script is Linux/macOS only
Several features are listed as TODO (voiceover-type editing, voice cloning, GPU-accelerated rendering)
keywords: make a video from clips by describing it
